title: Analyzing and Mitigating Cost-Inefficient Behaviors in Coding Agents
title_zh: 分析与缓解 Coding Agents 的成本低效行为
abstract_en: Although effective, coding agents often incur substantial monetary costs. Their recurring cost-inefficient behaviors remain underexplored. We conduct the first study of behavioral cost inefficiencies in coding agents, analyzing 1,200 trajectories from Claude Code and Mini-SWE-Agent across four configurations on SWE-bench Verified. We identify three cost-inefficient behaviors: subsumed retrieval, similar script generation, and test re-execution. We then evaluate three mitigation strategies: structure-aware retrieval, agent-synthesized skills, and developer-designed skills, over 10k trajectories on held-out SWE-bench Verified and Pro tasks. Our main findings are: (1) The three behaviors affect 79.00\%--98.00\% of coding tasks and account for up to 22.75\% of task cost. (2) Structure-aware retrieval can introduce retrieval overhead and alter agent delegation, causing inconsistent improvements in retrieval efficiency and cost increases of up to 28.14\%. (3) Agent-synthesized skills tend to produce low-level, trace-specific guidance, limiting their effectiveness and generality. (4) In contrast, developer-designed skills provide high-level, trace-agnostic guidance, reducing cost by up to 41.73\%, roughly twice the maximum gain from agent-synthesized skills.
abstract_zh: 本文首次系统研究 Coding Agents 的行为成本低效问题，分析了 Claude Code 和 Mini-SWE-Agent 在 SWE-bench Verified 四种配置下的 1,200 条轨迹，并在留出的 SWE-bench Verified 与 Pro 任务上评估超过 10,000 条轨迹。研究发现三类低效行为：被包含式检索（subsumed retrieval）、相似脚本生成（similar script generation）和测试重复执行（test re-execution）。这些行为影响 79.00%–98.00% 的任务，最多占任务成本的 22.75%。作者进一步评估了结构感知检索（structure-aware retrieval）、Agent 合成技能（agent-synthesized skills）和开发者设计技能（developer-designed skills）三种缓解策略。结构感知检索可能引入额外检索开销并改变 Agent 委派行为，效果不稳定，甚至使成本增加 28.14%；Agent 合成技能通常是低层次、依赖具体轨迹的指导，泛化能力有限；相比之下，开发者设计技能提供高层次且与轨迹无关的指导，最多可降低 41.73% 的成本，约为 Agent 合成技能最大收益的两倍。
key_points_zh: 识别出三类成本低效行为：被包含式检索、相似脚本生成和测试重复执行。
三类行为影响 79.00%–98.00% 的 Coding Agent 任务，最多占任务成本的 22.75%。
结构感知检索可能增加额外开销并改变 Agent 委派，最坏情况下使成本上升 28.14%。
Agent 合成技能往往过于低层次且依赖具体轨迹，导致效果和泛化能力受限。
开发者设计技能提供高层次、轨迹无关的指导，最多降低成本 41.73%，显著优于 Agent 合成技能。

llm_assessment.comment: This substantial coding-Agent study identifies recurring cost failures and provides actionable evidence that high-level developer-designed skills can improve operational efficiency.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 该研究系统识别了编码智能体的重复成本问题，并证明高层次开发者设计技能能够切实提升运行效率。
